definitions.trackRecord: Fastest valid lap across historical official F1 Grand Prix weekend practice, qualifying, sprint qualifying/shootout, sprint and Grand Prix race sessions for the relevant F1 circuit configuration. Private tests, demonstrations, invalidated laps and different configurations are excluded.
definitions.lapRecord: Fastest valid Grand Prix race lap for the relevant F1 circuit configuration; Sprint race laps are excluded.
definitions.firstGrandPrix: First World Championship Grand Prix at the circuit venue, including earlier configurations; Madring 2026 is scheduled, not a completed event.
definitions.lapsAndDistance: Scheduled 2026 full Grand Prix distance, not the shortened actual distance of a particular race.
definitions.lengthKm: Current 2026 Formula1.com circuit panel measurement; small measurement changes alone do not establish a new layout or reset records.

coverage.limitation: Minima are recomputed across retained official timing pages from each candidate record year onward, including every session type exposed by those event menus and separate FIA Sprint timing. Sessions before each comparisonFromYear have not been exhaustively audited. These are sourced record candidates, not automatically verified all-time claims.
coverage.layoutLimitation: Existing F1 configuration identity is retained for candidate comparison; exact historical configuration continuity and conflicting distance/record panels require human review before production.

circuits.name: Circuito de Madring
circuits.recordReason: First F1 weekend has not taken place at the as-of date.

verification.method: Official circuit panels and timing classifications, retained raw-source replay, and independent current-configuration record references; not exhaustive re-ingestion of every historical lap.

sourceSelections.rationale: The circuit operator and FIA-hosted promoter media kit explicitly retain Sainz 2020 as the lap record; the official 2020 Styrian GP fastest-laps table independently supplies the exact valid race lap. The same physical GP configuration is used; remeasurement does not turn a slower 2025 lap into an outright fastest lap.
Use the current 2026 race specification, independently corroborated on PDF page 16 of the 2026 FIA-hosted Japanese media kit; older race-distance editions are not current specifications.
